questions.stem: The locus of points equidistant from a single fixed point is:
questions.explanation: All points that are the same distance from a fixed point form a circle centred on that point.

questions.stem: The locus of points equidistant from two fixed points $A$ and $B$ is:
questions.explanation: Every point on the perpendicular bisector of $AB$ is exactly the same distance from $A$ as from $B$. This is the definition of the perpendicular bisector.
